operations.name: cloud.auth.status
operations.docs: Whether cmux is signed in to cmux Cloud and which team requests use. cmux answers from its own sign-in; the app server never sees a token.

operations.name: cloud.machine.list

items.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

operations.docs: List your Cloud machines and refresh the machine projection on this Mac. Read on page open, app activation and after every change; there is no polling. Alias: vm.list.

operations.name: cloud.machine.watch
operations.docs: The machine change stream. The catalog has no stream class yet, so this read answers the current projection revision; the server then sends cloud.machine.watch events after each op: {type: upsert, revision, machine} or {type: removed, revision, id}. One revision per projection change; no timer, no polling.

operations.name: cloud.machine.get

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

operations.docs: Read one machine and update it in the projection. Alias: vm.get.

operations.name: cloud.machine.create

displayName.description: Display name: 1 to 64 characters, no control characters.

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

title.ja: 新しいクラウドマシン

operations.docs: Create a machine. Needs an idempotency key: a retry with the same key returns the same machine and never creates a second one. Uses your plan quota. Alias: vm.create.

operations.name: cloud.machine.rename

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

operations.docs: Rename a machine; an empty name clears it. Alias: vm.update.

operations.name: cloud.machine.start

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

title.ja: クラウドマシンを起動

operations.docs: Start (resume) a paused machine. The server also accepts cloud.machine.resume, vm.start and vm.resume.

operations.name: cloud.machine.pause

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

title.ja: クラウドマシンを一時停止

operations.docs: Pause a machine. Its disk and sessions are kept. Alias: vm.pause.

operations.name: cloud.machine.resize

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

operations.docs: Resize a machine: cpu 1-32, memoryMb 4096-65536 in whole GiB, storageMb in 4 GiB steps up to 256 GiB. The result shows the plan limits. Alias: vm.resize.

operations.name: cloud.machine.delete

title.ja: クラウドマシンを削除…

operations.docs: Delete a machine and its disk. Only a person may delete: the host stamps origin user only after its native confirmation sheet; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP. Alias: vm.delete.

operations.name: cloud.machine.stats
operations.docs: Live CPU, memory and disk of a machine. A sleeping machine answers without being woken.

operations.name: cloud.machine.idle_policy.set
operations.docs: Set when an idle machine pauses (seconds of idle time, 0 = never). Not served yet: the cmux Cloud API has no idle policy route, so the server answers cmux.cloud.unsupported. Hidden on the CLI and MCP until the route exists.

operations.name: cloud.snapshot.list
operations.docs: Snapshots of a machine, newest first. Alias: vm.snapshot.list.

operations.name: cloud.snapshot.create

name.description: Display name: 1 to 64 characters, no control characters.

title.ja: クラウドマシンのスナップショットを作成

operations.docs: Take a snapshot of a machine. Alias: vm.snapshot.create.

operations.name: cloud.snapshot.restore

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

operations.docs: Create a new machine from a snapshot. A retry with the same idempotency key returns the same machine. Alias: vm.snapshot.restore.

operations.name: cloud.snapshot.fork

name.description: Display name: 1 to 64 characters, no control characters.

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

snapshotId.description: The snapshot the copy was made from.

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

title.ja: クラウドマシンをフォーク

operations.docs: Fork a machine: snapshot it and start a copy. A retry with the same idempotency key returns the same copy.

operations.name: cloud.snapshot.delete
operations.docs: Delete a snapshot of a machine. Only a person may delete (origin user, stamped by the host after its native confirmation). Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP. Alias: vm.snapshot.delete.

operations.name: cloud.plan.get
operations.docs: Your plan: machine limit, active machines, memory sizes the plan includes and the plan that adds larger ones. Read from the cmux Cloud API; cmux keeps no plan logic.

operations.name: cloud.usage.get
operations.docs: Machine hours used and included in this period (plans with an hour allowance) and the saved machine limit.

operations.name: cloud.machine.connect

carrier.description: cloud-vm/<machine>#<generation>; a new id after each reconnect.

socket.description: The link's local socket (owner-only directory) until the host passes a carrier fd.

title.ja: クラウドマシンに接続

operations.docs: Open the one private link (carrier) to a machine and return it. A second call while the link is up returns the same carrier and starts no new link. A paused machine is started first. Not a focus change. When the link goes down nothing reconnects by itself and nothing queues: call connect again, also with the same key: connect is never replayed from the ledger.

operations.name: cloud.machine.disconnect

title.ja: クラウドマシンから切断

operations.docs: End the link to a machine and forget it, also after a revocation. Every terminal of that machine on this Mac shows the disconnected state. The machine keeps running.

operations.name: cloud.rescue.open

focus.description: Focus the new terminal. Origin user always focuses it.

title.ja: クラウド救援シェルを開く

operations.docs: Open a shell on a machine whose cmux daemon does not answer (the cmux.terminal.backend/1 rescue kind). The new terminal gets focus only for origin user or focus true (focuses stays false: focus is not the op's purpose). Answers cmux.cloud.unsupported until the cmux Cloud API has an interactive shell route.

operations.name: cloud.network.list
operations.docs: List your private Cloud networks (GET /api/vm/network). The network records stay with the cmux Cloud API.

operations.name: cloud.tunnel.attach

deviceFingerprint.description: The stable per-install device fingerprint of the tunnel.

tunnelPurpose.description: Which tunnel of the device: browser (default) or terminal.

operations.docs: Attach a device's WireGuard tunnel to one of your private networks (POST /api/vm/tunnel/network/attach). It gives the device a path into the network. Only a person may run it: the host stamps origin user only after its native confirmation sheet; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP.

operations.name: cloud.tunnel.detach

deviceFingerprint.description: The stable per-install device fingerprint of the tunnel.

tunnelPurpose.description: Which tunnel of the device: browser (default) or terminal.

operations.docs: Detach a device's WireGuard tunnel from a private network (POST /api/vm/tunnel/network/detach). Needs an idempotency key.

operations.name: cloud.tunnel.rotate_key

deviceFingerprint.description: The stable per-install device fingerprint of the tunnel.

clientPublicKey.description: The WireGuard PUBLIC key of the tunnel (base64 of 32 bytes). Never a private key: the private key stays with cmux link.

tunnelPurpose.description: Which tunnel of the device: browser (default) or terminal.

clientConfig.description: WireGuard configuration with a blank PrivateKey line. An answer with a private key is refused.

operations.docs: Give a tunnel a new WireGuard public key; its address stays and the server public key changes (take the new [Peer] key from clientConfig) (POST /api/vm/tunnel/network/rotate-key). Takes the public key only; a value that is not base64 of 32 bytes is refused before any call. It gives the device a path into the network. Only a person may run it: the host stamps origin user only after its native confirmation sheet; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP.

operations.name: cloud.firewall.list
operations.docs: List the allow rules of your private network, optionally for one machine, network or tunnel (GET /api/vm/firewall).

operations.name: cloud.firewall.get
operations.docs: Read one firewall rule (GET /api/vm/firewall?ruleId=).

operations.name: cloud.firewall.create

source.description: One identity: vmId, vpcId, tunnelId, cidr, or public: true alone. port needs protocol; icmp takes no port.

destination.description: One identity: vmId, vpcId, tunnelId, cidr, or public: true alone. port needs protocol; icmp takes no port.

title.ja: クラウドのファイアウォールルールを追加…

operations.docs: Allow traffic from a source to a destination on your private network (POST /api/vm/firewall). It can open a machine to new traffic. The Cloud API does not dedup this create: after an attempt with no answer, a same-key retry answers cmux.cloud.outcome_unknown; list first, then retry with a new key. Only a person may run it: the host stamps origin user only after its native confirmation sheet; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP.

operations.name: cloud.firewall.delete
operations.docs: Delete one firewall rule (DELETE /api/vm/firewall?ruleId=). Only a person may run it: the host stamps origin user only after its native confirmation sheet; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP.

operations.name: cloud.domain.list
operations.docs: List your custom domains with their DNS records to add and the publications they route (GET /api/vm/domains).

operations.name: cloud.domain.verify
operations.docs: Start or refresh the DNS and certificate check of a custom domain (POST /api/vm/domains/:name/verify). An unknown host name claims a new zone; a verified zone takes its waiting publications live. Runs every time (no replay of an old answer). Needs an idempotency key.

operations.name: cloud.publication.list
operations.docs: List the machine ports you published on a host name (GET /api/vm/publications), optionally for one machine.

operations.name: cloud.publication.create

title.ja: クラウドマシンのポートを公開…

operations.docs: Publish an HTTP port of a machine on a host name (POST /api/vm/publications). A generated name when hostname is absent. Public access needs confirmPublic: true. A same-key retry after an answer returns that answer and makes no call. The Cloud API does not dedup this create: after an attempt with no answer, a same-key retry answers cmux.cloud.outcome_unknown; list first, then retry with a new key. Only a person may run it: the host stamps origin user only after its native confirmation sheet; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP.

operations.name: cloud.publication.update
operations.docs: Change who can open a publication (PATCH /api/vm/publications/:id). It can make a machine port public. Only a person may run it: the host stamps origin user only after its native confirmation sheet; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP.

operations.name: cloud.publication.delete
operations.docs: Stop publishing a machine port (DELETE /api/vm/publications/:id). Only a person may run it: the host stamps origin user only after its native confirmation sheet; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP.

operations.name: cloud.publication.verify
operations.docs: Re-check the DNS and certificate state of a publication (POST /api/vm/publications/:id/verify). A reserved publication whose zone is verified goes live. Runs every time (no replay of an old answer). Needs an idempotency key.

operations.name: cloud.fs.list

path.description: An absolute path on the machine: no .. segment, no NUL or control characters, at most 4096 bytes.

operations.docs: List a folder on a machine (cmux.fs.provider/1, scheme cloud-vm) through the Cloud API file route. One batch: the route has no cursor.

operations.name: cloud.fs.stat

path.description: An absolute path on the machine: no .. segment, no NUL or control characters, at most 4096 bytes.

operations.docs: Read the kind, size, mode and change time of one path on a machine.

operations.name: cloud.fs.read

path.description: An absolute path on the machine: no .. segment, no NUL or control characters, at most 4096 bytes.

operations.docs: Read a whole file of at most 16 MiB (base64). A larger file is refused with cmux.cloud.file_too_large before its bytes move. No ranges: the route reads whole files.

operations.name: cloud.fs.write

path.description: An absolute path on the machine: no .. segment, no NUL or control characters, at most 4096 bytes.

dataBase64.description: The new file content, at most 16 MiB.

baseRevision.description: Not supported: the Cloud API file route has no revision; a value is refused with cmux.cloud.unsupported.

operations.docs: Write a whole file (at most 16 MiB, atomic on the machine). Needs an idempotency key: a retry with the same key writes once. Writes files on the machine, so it needs fs:write. There is no conflict check (no revision on the route).

operations.name: cloud.fs.mkdir

path.description: An absolute path on the machine: no .. segment, no NUL or control characters, at most 4096 bytes.

operations.docs: Make a folder on a machine. Needs fs:write.

operations.name: cloud.fs.remove

path.description: An absolute path on the machine: no .. segment, no NUL or control characters, at most 4096 bytes.

title.ja: クラウドマシンのファイルを削除…

operations.docs: Remove a file or folder on a machine. Only a person may remove: the host stamps origin user only after its native confirmation; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP.

operations.name: cloud.file.push

localPath.description: An absolute file path on this Mac, without . or .. segments.

path.description: An absolute path on the machine: no .. segment, no NUL or control characters, at most 4096 bytes.

transfer.description: The transfer id; its cloud.file.transfer.changed event carries it.

operations.docs: Copy a local file to a machine over SSH through the machine's link. The server makes a new key in memory for each transfer and sends only its public half to the Cloud API; the guest host key is pinned from the Cloud API answer. Needs fs:write. Only a person may transfer: the local path reaches any file this Mac's user can read or write, so the host stamps origin user only after a native file panel; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP. The op answers at once with a transfer id (state running) while the copy runs off the op loop; its end is the event cloud.file.transfer.changed {transfer, machine, direction, path, localPath, state: done with bytes, failed with a typed error, or cancelled}. At most 4 transfers run at once; more get cmux.cloud.transfer_busy (retryable). cloud.file.transfer.cancel stops it.

operations.name: cloud.file.pull

localPath.description: An absolute file path on this Mac, without . or .. segments.

path.description: An absolute path on the machine: no .. segment, no NUL or control characters, at most 4096 bytes.

transfer.description: The transfer id; its cloud.file.transfer.changed event carries it.

operations.docs: Copy a file from a machine to this Mac, like cloud.file.push in the other direction. Never overwrites: an existing local path gets cmux.cloud.local_exists. Only a person may transfer: the local path reaches any file this Mac's user can read or write, so the host stamps origin user only after a native file panel; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP. The op answers at once with a transfer id (state running) while the copy runs off the op loop; its end is the event cloud.file.transfer.changed {transfer, machine, direction, path, localPath, state: done with bytes, failed with a typed error, or cancelled}. At most 4 transfers run at once; more get cmux.cloud.transfer_busy (retryable). cloud.file.transfer.cancel stops it.

operations.name: cloud.file.transfer.list

error.description: The typed error of a failed transfer, without its message.

title.ja: クラウドのファイル転送を一覧表示

operations.docs: The file transfers of this server: every running one (oldest start first), then the most recent finished ones (newest end first), so a new page session can show them again. The history keeps at most 32 finished transfers and none older than one hour (by the server's clock; nothing runs on a timer). Each entry: transfer, machine, direction (push or pull), state (running, done, failed or cancelled), started_at and, once ended, ended_at (epoch milliseconds), and error {code, retryable} for a failed one. Local paths and error messages are not listed (they can name local files).

operations.name: cloud.file.transfer.cancel

transfer.description: The transfer id from cloud.file.push or cloud.file.pull.

state.description: cancelling: the copy is being stopped; one cloud.file.transfer.changed event follows, state cancelled (or done for a push whose copy had already finished). ended: the transfer had already ended; no cancelled event follows.

operations.docs: Stop a running file transfer of this server. The copy stops (its OpenSSH child is killed) and a cancelled pull leaves no file. The op answers at once with state cancelling; the end is one cloud.file.transfer.changed event with state cancelled (a push that had already finished its copy reports done). Idempotent: a transfer that already ended answers state ended and no cancelled event follows (its own done or failed event goes out after the answer when the server had not sent it yet); an id this server never issued answers cmux.cloud.not_found. Never on MCP: agents cannot start transfers.

operations.name: cloud.port.list

generation.description: The link generation the forward rides; a new link gives a new forward.

operations.docs: List this Mac's port forwards to Cloud machines, up or down. It does not list the machine's listening ports (no route for that).

operations.name: cloud.port.forward

generation.description: The link generation the forward rides; a new link gives a new forward.

title.ja: クラウドマシンのポートを転送

operations.docs: Forward a port of the machine's localhost to 127.0.0.1 and a random port on this Mac, through the machine's link (a paused machine is started first). One forward per machine and port: a second call returns the same localPort. When the link goes down the forward goes down and nothing queues; call forward again for a new one. Never replayed from the idempotency ledger.

operations.name: cloud.port.close

title.ja: クラウドマシンのポート転送を停止

operations.docs: Close a port forward and every connection on it.

operations.name: cloud.browser.open

host.description: The machine itself: localhost (default), a name under .localhost, or a loopback IP. Any other host is refused.

operations.docs: Give the browser host a proxy route to the machine's localhost: an HTTP proxy on 127.0.0.1 that reaches only the machine (other hosts get 403) and the URL to load through it. It opens no browser tab; the browser host owns tabs.
